America's friendship with Taiwan is bigger than any one President.

Congress needs a steady vision to support Taiwan long-term, for both their security and our own.

I'm in Taiwan working to ensure our friendship stays strong, no matter who's in the White House.

posts.text:
Four years ago, the same gunfire I heard on the battlefield in Iraq rang out through Highland Park during a Fourth of July parade.

Seven lives cut short. A two-year-old orphaned. A community forever changed.

Enough has to be enough. 

Reinstate the assault weapons ban. Now.
